_comment: Words that mean the same in a business's name (Phase 20). Each group's words find each other in name searches: a search for "tacos" also finds "Taquería". Lower case or not, with or without accents; a phrase needs all its words. Kinds of business ("veterinaria", "estética") are read as categories first (packages/shared/src/search-keywords.ts), so these matter for the other words of a search. Load with `pnpm search:synonyms`; check with `pnpm search:bench`.
